biotools.summary: Free collection of 67 DNA and protein sequence tools and 44 lab calculators that run in the web browser, including reverse complement, translation, ORF finder, restriction maps, pairwise alignment, primer Tm, CRISPR guide finder, codon optimization, plasmid maps, and molarity, dilution, qPCR ΔΔCt and IC50 calculators. Sequences are processed on the user's device and never uploaded.
